title: PR #6490 moved structure-board rendering into a new generic render_object_structure admin endpoint and dropped the user_can_change_page check the old details() path applied, so any staff user can read the plugin structure of pages they may not view.

findings.explanation: No raw SQL queries are introduced in this diff. All changes are URL construction, import additions, and ORM-based lookups. No user-controlled input is concatenated into SQL strings.

Three new URL endpoints (render_object_edit, render_object_structure, render_object_preview) are registered under the PlaceholderAdmin URL patterns. The diff does not show the view implementations (cms/views.py is truncated/absent), so it is unclear whether these views enforce authentication, staff-only access, or object-level ownership checks. Because they are registered inside an admin URL pattern set, they inherit the admin URL namespace but admin URL registration alone does not guarantee that the admin login_required decorator is applied to custom views — only views routed through the admin's wrap() method get that protection. If render_object_edit/structure/preview are plain Django views imported directly, they may be accessible without authentication.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap each view with self.admin_site.admin_view() (e.g., pat(r'^object/([0-9]+)/edit/([0-9]+)/$', self.admin_site.admin_view(render_object_edit))) to ensure authentication and CSRF protection are enforced. Also verify that the view implementations perform object-level ownership/permission checks before serving content.
